plain_english: State-pair, called effect-doer-ness; effect-ness waning there, doer-ness again unwaning.
sanskrit_cite: avasthāyugalaṃ cātra kāryakartṛtvaśabditam | kāryatā kṣayiṇī tatra kartṛtvam punar akṣayam

plain_english: Whatever mere effort faces effect is lost here; when lost, 'I am utterly lost' — so the unwise holds.
sanskrit_cite: kāryonmukhaḥ prayatno yaḥ kevalaṃ so 'tra lupyate | tasmin lupte vilupto 'smīty abudhaḥ pratipadyate

plain_english: But who inward-facing, seat of all-knowingness: his loss never ever, from not perceiving other.
sanskrit_cite: na tu yo 'ntarmukho bhāvah sarvajñātvaguṇāspadam | tasya lopaḥ kadācit syād anyasyānupalambhanāt

plain_english: His perception ever, unfailing in three states; ever may it be of the fully awake — at beginning and end, but of the other.
sanskrit_cite: tasyopalabdhiḥ satataṃ tripadāvyabhicāriṇī | nityaṃ syāt suprabuddhasya tadādyante parasya tu

plain_english: Whose form is knowing and knowable, yoked by supreme power: in two states the pervader shines, elsewhere consciousness-made.
sanskrit_cite: jñānajñeyasvarūpiṇyā śaktyā paramayā yutaḥ | padadvaye vibhur bhāti tadanyatra tu cinmayaḥ

plain_english: Spanda-flows beginning with qualities, from resting in common spanda — who got self-getting ever may they be, of the unopposed knower.
sanskrit_cite: guṇādispandaniḥṣyandāḥ sāmānyaspandasaṃśrayāt | labdhātmalābhaḥ satataṃ syur jñasyāparipanthinaḥ
